reference: The farmer smiles kindly and gives her a peach.
sk: Farmár sa prívetivo usmeje a dá jej broskyňu.
cz: Farmář se přívětivě usměje a dá jí broskev.
acceptable: The farmer smiles {kindly|warmly} and {gives|hands} her a peach.
The farmer smiles {kindly|warmly} and gives a peach to her.
The farmer {kindly|warmly} smiles and {gives|hands} her a peach.
The farmer will smile {kindly|warmly} and {will give|give} her a peach.

mistakes.text: The farmer smiles kind and gives her a peach.
The farmer smiles friendly and gives her a peach.
The farmer smiles in a friendly way and gives her a peach.
The farmer smile kindly and give her a peach.
The farmer smiles kindly and gives to her a peach.

source_issues: Native perfective verbs 'usmeje/dá' can read as future; will-versions accepted.
